description: This Java class models a single form element in the OFBiz widget framework, representing the <form> element as an immutable data structure with methods for handling parent form relationships.

classes.name: ModelSingleForm
classes.description: Represents a read-only model of a single form element, extending ModelForm, with logic to determine parent form relationships.

methods.name: ModelSingleForm
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the form model from an XML element and context objects.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing ModelWidgetVisitor to perform operations on this form model.

methods.name: getParentModel
methods.description: Determines and returns the parent form model based on 'extends-resource' or 'extends' attributes in the XML element.
